issue.title: Harvest the remaining Claude auto-memory notes into reviewed SASE memory

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by sase-1ko.7 (notes #1 and #15), as the approved E3 plan's foreign_memory decision requires
("`claude` records a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP to harvest the two remaining non-empty auto-memory
directories ... as one `memory` task bead").

E3 now turns Claude auto-memory off per invocation (`autoMemoryEnabled: false` in the per-run
`--settings`) whenever `claude_explicit_instructions` delivers explicitly, so these notes are no
longer read by any SASE run and memory review never saw them. Review each and either fold the
durable lesson into reviewed SASE memory or discard it:

- `~/.claude/projects/-home-bryan--local-state-sase-workspaces-sase-org-sase-sase-16/memory/`
  - `png-golden-conflict-repair.md` (Sep 25) -> likely `tui_screenshot.md` / `tui.md` PNG golden guidance
  - `sase-screenshot-mutates-real-ace-state.md` (Sep 25) -> likely `tui_screenshot.md`
  - `MEMORY.md` (index only)
- `~/.claude/projects/-home-bryan--local-state-sase-workspaces-sase-org-sase-sase-12/memory/`
  - `actstat-and-ci-watch-live-on-athena.md` (Sep 15) -> likely `tailnet.md` or the actstat project, if still true
  - `MEMORY.md` (index only)

No auto-memory file is newer than Sep 25. Memory edits need the owner's permission and
`sase memory init`; delete the auto-memory files only after the content is migrated or rejected.
